editorial_contributions.text: Summary: We present a survey of the state of knowledge concerning the chromatic number of regions of \(\mathbb{R}^2\) bounded by a circle or by two parallel lines. Several of the designs we describe are hitherto unpublished and improve on previously known bounds. The authorship denotes that this work is a product of the Polymath 16 project.

editorial_contributions.text:
Summary: In set theory without the axiom of choice (AC), we observe new relations of the following statements with weak choice principles.
\begin{itemize}
\item If in a partially ordered set, all chains are finite and all antichains are countable, then the set is countable.
\item If in a partially ordered set, all chains are finite and all antichains have size \(\aleph_{\alpha}\), then the set has size \(\aleph_{\alpha}\) for any regular \(\aleph_{\alpha}\).
\item Every partially ordered set without a maximal element has two disjoint cofinal sub sets -- CS.
\item Every partially ordered set has a cofinal well-founded subset -- CWF.
\item Dilworth's decomposition theorem for infinite partially ordered sets of finite width -- DT.
\end{itemize}
We also study a graph homomorphism problem and a problem due to \textit{A. Hajnal} [Combinatorica 5, No. 2, 137--139 (1985; Zbl 0575.05029)] without AC. Further, we study a few statements restricted to linearly-ordered structures without AC.

editorial_contributions.text: Summary: Colorings of disk graphs arise in the study of the frequency-assignment problem in broadcast networks. Motivated by the observation that the chromatic number of graphs modeling real networks hardly exceeds their clique number, we examine the related properties of the unit disk graphs and their different generalizations. For all these graphs, including the most general class of the double disk graphs, it is shown that \(\chi(G)\leq c\cdot\omega(G)\) for a constant \(c\). Several coloring algorithms are analyzed for disk graphs, with the aim of improving the bounds on \(\chi(G)\). We find that their worst-case performance expressed in terms of the number of colors used is indeed reached in some instances.
